title: Vulnerability management
summary: Finding, rating, fixing and verifying technical vulnerabilities on infrastructure, applications and AI pipelines, with SLAs and an exception path.

title: Incident management
summary: From the first report to the post-incident review: triage, containment, evidence, notifications, recovery and exercises, including AI-specific incidents.

title: Access review
summary: Periodic certification of user, privileged, third-party and AI-system access against job role, with revocation and evidence.

title: Change management
summary: Raising, assessing, approving, testing, implementing and reviewing changes to systems, security controls and AI models.

title: Backup and recovery
summary: Backup policy, recovery objectives, protected copies, restore testing, disaster-recovery exercises and retention.

title: Third-party risk
summary: Tiering, assessing, contracting, onboarding, monitoring and offboarding suppliers, including AI providers.

title: Security awareness
summary: Onboarding and refresher training, phishing simulations, role-based and AI-use training, management briefings and measurement.

title: Logging and monitoring
summary: Logging standard, log sources, central platform, SIEM operation, alert triage, retention, privacy and AI event logging.

title: Asset management
summary: Inventories of hardware, software, SaaS, information and AI assets; ownership, classification, acceptable use, discovery and disposal.

title: Policy lifecycle
summary: Framework, requirements mapping, drafting, review, approval, publication, acknowledgement, exceptions and periodic review of policies.

title: AI system lifecycle (ISO 42001)
summary: Objectives, registration, impact assessment, data governance, development, validation, deployment, monitoring, incidents and retirement of AI systems.

title: Cloud security posture
summary: Cloud standards, service approval, account inventory, landing-zone hardening, guardrails, posture scanning, remediation, identities, exposure and exit planning.
